title: Rigid bodies I: the inertia tensor and Euler's equations
summary: Angular velocity and the body frame; the inertia tensor, principal axes and the parallel-axis theorem; angular momentum versus angular velocity; Euler's equations and torque-free motion, including the intermediate-axis instability.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.09 Chapter 2 (Rigid Body Dynamics) and Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 3.

preparation.description: Read 8.09 Chapter 2, Rigid Body Dynamics (PDF), first half: kinematics, inertia tensor, Euler's equations.
Read Tong, Classical Dynamics, Chapter 3 The Motion of Rigid Bodies (reference-only), the sections on the inertia tensor and Euler's equations.
Re-read the angular-momentum passage of 8.09 Chapter 1, Section 1.3 (PDF page 13).
